title: Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce
description:
Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce


Visão Geral da Posição

O Desenvolvedor Sênior de Marketing Cloud será responsável por desenvolver soluções dentro da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud para apoiar funções críticas de negócio e atender aos requisitos de projetos.

Essa função exige uma combinação sólida de proficiência técnica, pensamento criativo e atenção aos detalhes . O profissional colaborará de perto com equipes de marketing, design, dados e gestão de campanhas para entregar experiências digitais impactantes que envolvam milhões de clientes.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções complexas de automação de marketing utilizando o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Cloud Pages e Mobile Studio).
  • Implementar personalização e segmentação baseadas em dados , utilizando Data Extensions, consultas SQL e lógica AMPscript .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar Cloud Pages, formulários e landing pages integradas aos dados e APIs do Marketing Cloud.
  • Criar e manter jornadas e automações para campanhas gatilhadas, comportamentais e de ciclo de vida .
  • Projetar e implementar fluxos de integração de dados entre o SFMC e outros sistemas (Sales/Service Cloud, CDP ou fontes de dados externas).
  • Criar e gerenciar Data Extensions, atividades de consulta e processos de automação para garantir fluxo de dados eficiente.
  • Trabalhar com APIs (REST/SOAP) e Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) para integrações avançadas e conteúdo dinâmico.
  • Seguir padrões de codificação e melhores práticas dentro do ecossistema Marketing Cloud.
  • Atuar como especialista técnico (SME) em todos os trabalhos de desenvolvimento relacionados ao SFMC.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e equipes de operações de marketing para impulsionar melhorias na plataforma e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de marketing e design para transformar conceitos criativos em soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar códigos e orientar desenvolvedores juniores , garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos , otimizando para velocidade, confiabilidade e engajamento.
  • Supervisionar testes de renderização e entregabilidade utilizando ferramentas como o Litmus .
  • Manter altos padrões de privacidade de dados, conformidade (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) e segurança.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de analytics para estabelecer rastreamento de performance, relatórios e insights a partir dos dados do SFMC.
  • Avaliar continuamente novos recursos do SFMC, atualizações e melhores práticas do mercado para aprimorar as capacidades da plataforma.
  • Explorar e implementar recursos de IA, personalização e inteligência preditiva dentro do Marketing Cloud.


Habilidades e Experiência:

  • Graduação em TI, Ciência da Computação ou área equivalente , com 7 a 10 anos de experiência em TI e mínimo de 5 anos com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) e compreensão dos conceitos essenciais de e-mail marketing e automação .
  • Experiência com Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automations, SQL, Content Builder e criação de audiências para Advertising Studio .
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS, JavaScript e AMPscript para desenvolvimento de e-mails.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e experiência em testes e depuração de e-mails usando o Litmus .
  • Compreensão das melhores práticas da Salesforce para automação de marketing .
  • Capacidade e vontade de trabalhar com alto grau de autonomia e senso de propriedade em uma equipe geograficamente distribuída , composta por outros desenvolvedores e recursos de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal .
  • Ingles avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Sales Executive - Shipyards & Shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales


Role Summary


The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.


Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.


Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

description:

É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

  • antes/depois, raciocínio de UX e decisões de layout;
  • exemplos de coleções dinâmicas, componentes reutilizáveis e interações;

Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.

title: Consultor SAP ABAP PI Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP | WF | PI/PO

Contrato PJ | 12 meses | 100% remoto

Objetivo

Atuar no design, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções SAP com foco em ABAP, Workflows complexos e integrações via PI/PO, assegurando qualidade técnica e estabilidade dos fluxos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter objetos ABAP: reports (básicos e avançados), ALV OO, módulos de função, Module Pool, BAPIs, BDC, Smart Forms e OO ABAP.
  • Implementar enhancements: implicit/explicit, BADIs, User Exits.
  • Projetar, construir e administrar SAP Business Workflow: fluxos complexos, notificações repetitivas, work items dinâmicos, tarefas em background, questionários, anexos por e-mail e troubleshooting.
  • Criar integrações INBOUND/OUTBOUND entre SAP e legados via PI/PO e Proxy ABAP.
  • Configurar integrações: destinos RFC (R/3 e PI), portas, perfis de parceiro, sistemas lógicos e proxy ABAP.
  • Configurar e testar adaptadores: HTTP, HTTPS, FTPS, SOAP, REST.
  • Elaborar e executar testes: unitário, integração e interfaces PI/PO; preparar documentação técnica e de mapeamento.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em SAP ABAP com os itens citados acima.
  • Vivência comprovada em SAP Business Workflow com administração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Experiência prática em PI/PO: cenários síncronos/assíncronos, mapeamentos, monitoramento e performance.
  • Configuração de RFC, parceiros e proxies ABAP.
  • Preparação de planos e evidências de teste.
  • Boa organização para documentar especificação técnica e de mapeamento.


Diferenciais

  • Boas práticas de performance ABAP e troubleshooting de integrações.
  • Noções de segurança em integrações e tratamento de erros.
  • Experiência com governança de mudanças e versionamento.


Modelo e condições

  • Contrato: PJ.
  • Período: 12 meses, com possibilidade de extensão conforme entrega e demanda.
  • Local: 100% remoto.
  • Dedicação: integral (40h/semana) ou a combinar conforme volume.

title: Pessoa Especialista em Segurança da Informação
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Monitorar e analisar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM (ex: Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar).
  • Responder a incidentes de segurança (IR) com base em playbooks e procedimentos padronizados.
  • Realizar investigações forenses e análise de comportamento de ameaças (UEBA).
  • Criar e manter alertas inteligentes, regras de correlação e casos de uso de segurança.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de DevSecOps e Engenharia de Segurança para melhorar continuamente os controles e a detecção.
  • Documentar incidentes, elaborar postmortems de segurança, e realizar melhorias preventivas.
  • Apoiar simulações de ataque e resposta a incidentes (ex: tabletop exercises).
  • Produzir relatórios de inteligência e manter o time atualizado sobre táticas, técnicas e procedimentos (TTPs) utilizadas por agentes de ameaça.
  • Avaliar continuamente a eficácia das ferramentas de SOC e propor ajustes técnicos.
  • Garantir aderência às normas de compliance e governança, como ISO 27001, NIST e LGPD.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • SIEMs: Splunk, Azure Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic SIEM ou similares.
  • Ferramentas de EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, Defender ATP, SentinelOne, Carbon Black.
  • Ferramentas de Threat Intel: MISP, VirusTotal, OpenCTI.
  • Protocolos de rede e logs: Syslog, NetFlow, PCAP, HTTP, DNS, LDAP, etc.
  • Experiência com automação e resposta com SOAR (ex: Phantom, Demisto).
  • Familiaridade com MITRE ATT&CK e uso de frameworks de cibersegurança. Conhecimentos básicos de scripts: Python, Bash ou PowerShell (desejável).
  • Certificações como CompTIA Security+, CEH, GCIA, GCFA ou equivalente são diferenciais.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Senior Data Administrator
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Data Administrator who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid (with the possibility of 100% remote) , in the city of Londrina.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES *

Main Responsibilities

● Data Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain relational and multidimensional data models to meet the requirements of transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Warehouse) systems.


● Metadata Management: Manage the data catalog, defining business concepts, maintaining data lineage, and ensuring that metadata is clear and accessible.


● Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality rules, identify anomalies, and collaborate with business and development teams to correct inconsistencies.

● Data Governance: Support the creation, curation, and evolution of best practice guides and standards for data modeling and integration, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations such as the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law).

● Implementation and Curation: Create and curate physical data models in databases, ensuring that the implementation is aligned with the logical design.

● Technical Collaboration: Act as a point of reference for development, BI, and data science teams, offering support and expertise on issues related to data structure and access.


Nice to Have:

● Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) applied to data projects (DataOps).

● Knowledge of other data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation). ● Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), especially with database and data lake services.

● Advanced or fluent English for collaboration with global teams.

● Previous experience in the company's sector (e.g., finance, retail, industry).


JOB REQUIREMENTS


MINIMUM REQUIREMENT FOR THE POSITION * DESIRABLE

Education Experience

Minimum Education and Experience

● Education: Completed and proven higher education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields. Short courses or predominantly online courses will not be considered as primary education.

● Experience: Minimum of 6 years of market experience, working directly with data modeling, administration, and governance.

● Professional Stability: Average of 2 years of tenure in previous jobs, according to resume history. Certifications (Desirable)

● At least one active certification, such as:

○ DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Associate or Practitioner level.

○ Certification in specific tools (e.g., Informatica, Oracle).


Technical Skills

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

● Proficiency in relational (3NF) and dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake) data modeling.

● Proven experience with data modeling tools, preferably Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler.

● Solid knowledge of Data Governance tools for Catalog, Lineage, and Quality, preferably the Informatica suite (IDMC/Axon/EDC).

● In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and its application in data architectures.

● Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.


● Knowledge of Data Warehousing, Data Marts, and Business Intelligence concepts. Behavioral Competencies (Soft Skills)

● Analytical Vision: Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.

● Assertive Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences (technical and business).

● Organization and Focus: Discipline to manage multiple projects and priorities autonomously.

title: Coordenador de Arquitetura de Sistemas
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Principais atividades:

Coordenar equipe de arquitetos de software.

Avaliar a arquitetura atual, identificar necessidades de integração e projetar novas soluções.

Desenvolver modelos de arquitetura: Criar diagramas e documentação para descrever como os sistemas se interconectam e como a solução será implementada.

Escolher tecnologias: Selecionar as ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para a integração, considerando fatores como desempenho, segurança e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com outras áreas: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes, como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura e segurança da informação, para garantir entrega eficiente da solução.

Manter-se atualizado: Acompanhar as tendências e tecnologias de integração, buscando soluções e abordagens mais eficazes.

Ensino superior completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.

Experiência de trabalho comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções ou função similar.

Experiência em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.

Inglês intermediário ou fluente.

Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem: usando Kubernetes e Openshift para eficiência e escalabilidade dos serviços.

Conhecimentos em segurança: Capacidade de projetar e implementar soluções de integração que sejam seguras e protegidas.

Conhecimento técnico: Sólidos conhecimentos em várias linguagens de programação, sistemas operacionais e bancos de dados.

Conhecimento de tecnologias de integração: Familiaridade com ferramentas e tecnologias de integração, como plataformas de integração de aplicativos (APIs), plataformas de integração de eventos (ESBs) como Kafka e RabbitMQ e de ferramentas de ETL.

Habilidades de liderança: Capacidade de liderar equipes e projetos, garantindo a implementação bem-sucedida da solução.


Competências comportamentais:


Adaptação à mudanças;

Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções;

Entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades e direcionamentos;

Capacidade de assumir responsabilidades;

Trabalho em equipe:

Proatividade;

Comprometimento com as entregas;

Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;

title: Engenheiro de dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.


O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.


Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados: projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.


Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL/SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Desenvolver jobs Spark/Flink e para data-warehouses colunares;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift/BigQuery/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados: Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;
  • Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.


Stack desejável:

  • Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake;
  • Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS);
  • Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub;
  • Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations;
  • Terraform/IaC, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in transit).


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados: Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.


Segue abaixo os benefícios oferecidos:

  • Auxílio home-office;
  • Nossa forma de trabalho é totalmente home-office permitindo que você esteja sempre perto de quem mais importa;
  • Descontos em academias através do Total Pass;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional aqui é primordial, por isso oferecemos um programa de capacitação online onde você recebe R$300,00 de crédito semestralmente para adquirir cursos na plataforma Udemy;

title: Especialista em segurança
description:
A Stone está com uma oportunidade em seu time de Segurança em Desenvolvimento (AppSec) na área de Segurança da Informação para trabalhar com foco em projetos de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais! Você gosta de buscar novos desafios e adquirir novos conhecimentos para acelerar o desenvolvimento de carreira? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time de Segurança da Informação, como Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior na Stone!

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.


Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior?


Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão:


Estratégia, Colaboração e Arquitetura Segura em IA:

  • Ser o ponto focal de segurança, colaborando diretamente com times de engenharia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Participar e conduzir ativamente revisões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em IA, desde a concepção até a fase de produção.
  • Realizar threat modeling específico para identificar e mitigar vetores de ataque exclusivos de sistemas de IA.
  • Desenvolver e manter um programa de segurança, abrangendo atividades defensivas e ofensivas, para aplicações de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).

Domínio de Riscos e Vulnerabilidades de Segurança em IA:

  • Possuir profundo conhecimento em riscos de segurança e privacidade específicos de IA, incluindo (mas não limitado a) o OWASP Top 10 for LLMs :
  • Prompt Injection e técnicas de jailbreak.
  • Insecure Output Handling e riscos de execução de código.
  • Data Poisoning em datasets de treino/fine-tuning.
  • Model Denial of Service e ataques de exaustão de recursos.
  • Vulnerabilidades na cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) de modelos, dados e dependências.
  • Vazamento de Informações Sensíveis (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
  • Insecure Plugin Design e riscos associados a tool/function calling.
  • Excessive Agency em sistemas e agentes autônomos.
  • Ataques de Inversão de Modelo e Inferência de Membro (Model Inversion/Membership Inference Attacks).
  • Roubo de Modelo (Model Theft).

Segurança em Arquiteturas e Componentes Específicos de IA:

  • Avaliação de Pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): Foco em segurança de Vector databases, embeddings, estratégias de chunking e manipulação/injeção de contexto.
  • Revisão de Sistemas de Agentes Autônomos: Análise de limites de execução de tools/functions, segurança de memória/contexto persistente do agente e transparência de raciocínio (chain-of-thought).
  • Protocolos e Integrações: Avaliar a segurança do Model Context Protocol (MCP) e integrações.
  • Fluxos de Fine-tuning: Analisar workflows de fine-tuning e riscos de injeção de backdoors.
  • Controles de Segurança: Validar a implementação de guardrails e sistemas de filtragem de conteúdo (content filtering).

Governança, Compliance e Maturidade em IA:

  • Aplicar frameworks de avaliação de maturidade em segurança de IA (ex: OWASP AI Maturity Assessment).
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações emergentes (ex: AI Act, Executive Orders) e suas implicações técnicas.
  • Implementar controles de privacidade diferencial e minimização de dados.
  • Estabelecer políticas de governança de modelos e versionamento seguro.

Capacidades Técnicas e Operacionais:

  • Ciclo de Vida de LLMs: Conhecimento aprofundado em pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, padrões de deployment (API-based, on-premise, edge) e implicações de segurança do prompt engineering.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar a detecção de model drift, bias drift, concept drift e métricas de segurança (ex: toxicity scores, jailbreak attempts, PII leakage). Realizar anomaly detection e auditoria de prompts e outputs.
  • Infraestrutura de IA em Cloud: Experiência com serviços gerenciados de LLM (ex: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI), segurança de containers para workloads de ML/AI, gerenciamento de segredos (secrets management) e isolamento de rede.

Testes e Validação de Segurança:

  • Conduzir security assessments de aplicações baseadas em LLM utilizando metodologias específicas.
  • Realizar exercícios simulando ataques como prompt injection, jailbreak, cenários de exfiltração de dados e adversarial inputs.
  • Validar controles de rate limiting, prevenção de abuso e gerenciamento de custos.
  • Testar sandboxing e isolamento para execução de código.


Outras Contribuições e Habilidades:

  • Avaliar riscos e definir requisitos e padrões de segurança.
  • Realizar revisões de código e design de arquitetura.
  • Implementar testes de segurança automatizados e auxiliar na mitigação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Promover o treinamento e a sensibilização dos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Integrar segurança de forma eficiente nos processos de desenvolvimento (shift-left).
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências de segurança em IA.
  • Utilizar a experiência e intuição de segurança para buscar ameaças nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.
  • Ter iniciativa para buscar ou solicitar dados importantes que estejam ausentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções criativas e complexas que equilibrem riscos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade plena de leitura e comunicação eficiente em inglês.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias, novas soluções e alertas que possam beneficiar e/ou facilitar a operação
  • Usar habilidades de influência e negociação para direcionar os times a corrigirem problemas ou a utilizar arquiteturas adequadas do ponto de vista de segurança
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia
  • Interesse e dedicação em aprender e se adaptar a cenários que utilizam novas tecnologias com as quais ainda não teve contato e que entreguem mais segurança aos produtos
  • Comunicar-se de forma concisa, franca e assertiva, sabendo traduzir problemas complexos para uma linguagem acessível ao público com o qual se comunica
  • Possuir curso Superior (concluído ou em andamento) em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Inteligência Artificial ou cursos relacionados
  • Paixão por aprender e prosperar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança
  • Conhecimento de vetores de ataque comuns
  • Conhecimento dos serviços básicos e conceitos de segurança de Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Experiência com monitoramento de segurança, análise de logs e ferramentas forenses
  • Facilidade de trabalhar dentro de times multi-disciplinares com metodologia ágil



O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Desenvolvimento de software: conhecimentos que permitam criar códigos para funcionalidades e integrações pontuais, em especial Python
  • Experiência e conhecimento em tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais usando LLM (Large Language Model)
  • Experiência com gestão de incidentes, vulnerabilidade, riscos,etc
  • Experiência com guidelines e ferramentas OWASP

title: Product Manager - E-commerce & Analytics (Remote, Japanese Essential)
description:
Your Rare Combination of Skills Could Transform Japan Travel


Most ECommerce Product Managers understand data. Some speak Japanese. Almost none have both.


If you're that rare person who can analyze a conversion funnel in GA4 and negotiate with Japanese rail partners in their language, keep reading.


The Reality Check (Read This First)


This role is NOT for you if:

  • Your Japanese is conversational but not business-level
  • Your PM experience is in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or physical products
  • You've never optimized an e-commerce checkout flow
  • You think GA4 is "just another analytics tool"
  • You prefer project management to product strategy


This role IS for you if:

  • You can run a business meeting in Japanese (not just order dinner)
  • You've spent years obsessing over why customers abandon carts
  • You know the difference between bounce rate and exit rate without Googling
  • You've built conversion funnels, not just analyzed them
  • You understand Japanese business culture (consensus-building, relationship-first communication)


What You'll Actually Do

Week 1-3: Become Our Detective

  • Dive into our GA4 setup and immediately spot what's broken
  • Interview customers who bought passes and those who didn't
  • Map every click from Google search to booking confirmation
  • Present findings that make us uncomfortable (in a good way)


Month 2-3: Fix What's Bleeding

  • Our conversion rate is 2%. Industry standard is 3-4%. Find the leaks.
  • Work with our Polish dev team to implement quick wins
  • Set up proper tracking so we stop flying blind
  • Run your first A/B test and actually know if it worked


Month 4-6: Build the Future

  • Achieve Product-Market fit for JapanDen.com through user research and behavioral analysis
  • Design the user journey for JapanDen.com (our content platform)
  • Launch point-to-point ticket sales (our 2-3x revenue opportunity)
  • Travel to Japan, sit with rail company partners, negotiate in Japanese
  • Become the person both our UK team and Japanese suppliers trust


Your Background

Must Have (Non-Negotiable):

  • Business-level Japanese - You've used it professionally, not just studied it
  • 3-5 years as a Product Manager in consumer e-commerce (D2C or B2C)
  • Hands-on GA4 experience - Custom events, conversion tracking, cohort analysis
  • Proven conversion optimization - You can tell us percentage improvements you've driven
  • E-commerce fundamentals - Product pages, checkout flows, cart abandonment strategies
  • Product-Market fit expertise - User research, market analysis, and translating customer behavior into product strategy


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in travel/tourism/hospitality
  • Technical background (can write basic SQL, understand APIs)
  • Living in a timezone within 5 hours of UK (but not required)
  • Experience working with Asian business partners


Don't Need:

  • CS degree or coding skills
  • Previous team management experience
  • Design skills (we have designers)


Why This Isn't Another Corporate PM Role

The Good:

  • Autonomy - You'll own the product roadmap, not execute someone else's vision
  • Impact - Your work affects millions of Japan travelers directly
  • Growth - We're profitable and expanding, not fighting for runway
  • Culture - 15 people globally, no corporate bureaucracy
  • Flexibility - Truly remote, work your hours, judge by output not activity


The Challenging:

  • You'll be the analytics expert - Our current PM doesn't use GA4, you'll need to lead here
  • Small team - No PM team to learn from, you'll need to be self-directed
  • Multiple platforms - JRPass.com (established) and JapanDen.com (startup mode)
  • Cultural bridge - Japanese partners expect relationship-building, UK team wants data and speed


The Reality:

  • You'll work with developers in Poland (4 people)
  • Report to Managing Director (day-to-day) and Head of Product (relationships)
  • Collaborate with growth marketer in Brazil
  • Travel to Japan 2x yearly (we pay, this is work not vacation)


Our Situation (Full Transparency)

Where We Are:

  • £30M+ annual revenue
  • Record organic traffic post-COVID
  • Conversion rate stuck at 2% (should be 3%+)
  • Limited analytics sophistication (we know this is a problem)


Where We're Going:

  • Launch point-to-point tickets (doubles addressable market)
  • Grow JapanDen.com into Japan's top travel authority site
  • Expand into hotels and activities
  • Potentially 2-3x revenue in 2-3 years


What We Need:

Someone who can figure out why our highest-ever traffic isn't converting, then fix it. Not theoretically - actually fix it with code changes, design tweaks, and A/B tests.


Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $50,000 - $70,000 USD annually (adjusted based on location)

  • We pay competitively for your market, not London rates
  • You'll likely earn more in purchasing power than UK-based equivalent


Benefits:

  • 20-25 days holiday + local public holidays
  • Pension/retirement contribution
  • Japan travel fully covered (2x yearly, 3-5 days each trip)
  • Flexible working hours (core overlap with UK business hours)
  • Home office stipend
  • Professional development budget


Why We're Being This Specific

Honestly? We've interviewed 30+ candidates. Many speak Japanese. Many are claiming Japanese skills. Others are business development or marketing people, not ecommerce product managers.


We need someone who actually fits this unusual profile: Japanese fluency + consumer e-commerce Product Mgr + analytics expertise + cultural bridge-building.


If that's you - genuinely you, not close-enough-you - we want to talk.


Our Team (15 People Globally)

  • London: 5 admin team members + Managing Director
  • Poland: 4 developers (your partners in building features)
  • Brazil: Growth marketer + social media
  • Current Head of Product: 15 years with company, manages supplier relationships
  • You: The analytics-driven, customer-obsessed PM we need


Three Final Thoughts:


1. On Japanese Language:

If you're thinking "my Japanese is probably good enough" - it's not. This role requires daily business use. If you can't negotiate contract terms or explain complex analytics concepts in Japanese, this won't work.


2. On E-commerce Experience:

B2B SaaS product management is different. Marketplace product management is different. We need someone who understands consumer purchase psychology, checkout optimization, and conversion funnels in retail contexts.


3. On Remote Work:

We're not "remote-friendly" - we're remote-first. But we need overlap with UK business hours (roughly 9am-6pm GMT). Think about whether your timezone works before applying.


Ready to Transform How Millions Experience Japan?

This is a rare role for a rare person.


If you have the unusual combination of skills we need, you'll have autonomy, impact, and growth opportunities most PMs don't get until much later in their careers.


JRPass.com is the world's leading Japan Rail Pass provider, helping millions of travellers explore Japan affordably and authentically. We're a profitable, growing company with 15 years of track record, expanding from rail passes into the comprehensive Japan travel platform.

We don't care where you're based, what degree you have, or whether you fit a traditional career path. We care that you can speak Japanese, optimize conversion funnels, and bridge two cultures. Everything else, we can teach.

description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated

- Pay close attention to detail 

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $7000 USD per month

description:
English-speaking Microsoft 365 Consultant


$3,500 – $5,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP delivering enterprise-grade Microsoft 365, Azure, and multi-cloud solutions to global clients.

Their teams help organizations secure, optimize, and modernize their Microsoft ecosystems — improving collaboration, compliance, and operational efficiency across M365, Azure, and hybrid environments.


You’ll be part of a specialist Microsoft 365 Center of Excellence, working alongside senior engineers and consultants who design, implement, and manage advanced enterprise environments.

This is a long-term remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class Microsoft ecosystem — with exposure to architecture, automation, governance, and continuous service improvement.


The Role

As a Microsoft 365 Consultant, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of operational, architectural, administrative, and consultative responsibilities across enterprise M365 environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and advisory position — blending technical depth with strategic consulting. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to keep their Microsoft 365 ecosystems secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You’ll work on:


  • Leading monthly environment reviews and recommending strategic improvements
  • (Secure Score, license optimization, usage insights, product roadmap updates)
  • Designing and maintaining Microsoft 365 architectures aligned with Microsoft best practices
  • Configuring and deploying M365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, etc.)
  • Monitoring service health, telemetry, and usage to proactively resolve issues
  • Performing incident, request, and change management activities
  • Contributing to documentation including configuration designs and operational procedures
  • Collaborating in change control, adoption, and stabilization meetings
  • Coordinating with Microsoft Support when escalations are required


This is not a traditional support role — you’ll engage directly with customers, provide insights on modernization, and shape the future of their Microsoft 365 environments.


What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years’ experience in Microsoft 365 administration, engineering, or consulting
  • Hands-on expertise in Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance, and security best practices in M365
  • Experience managing and optimizing Microsoft licensing, consumption, and usage reporting
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting, automation, and M365 monitoring tools
  • Ability to conduct environmental health checks and present improvement recommendations
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills


Who You Are

  • A trusted Microsoft 365 specialist who loves solving complex technical challenges
  • A consultative communicator comfortable advising enterprise clients directly
  • A self-starter who can manage multiple customer environments independently
  • A continuous learner, always keeping up with new Microsoft releases and best practices
  • A team player who thrives in a high-performing, collaborative culture


Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Work fully remote from anywhere
  • Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month
  • Long-term engagement with enterprise US clients
  • Focus on certification and career growth (Microsoft exams covered every 6 months)
  • Exposure to advanced Microsoft environments and governance frameworks
  • Collaborative, senior-level culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

  • Recolocar vedações das placas do filtro, desmontando partes mecânicas, conjuntos e subconjuntos, substituindo peças, efetuando a montagem dos equipamentos, verificando o funcionamento dentro dos padrões preestabelecidos;
  • Participar da realização de serviços de manutenção de maior grau de complexidade; efetuando a desmontagem, substituição de peças e montagem de conjuntos e subconjuntos;
  • Realizar correções de baixo rendimento, removendo, limpando e recolocando placas de filtros, trocando anéis de vedação e fazendo ajustes.


Instrução

  • Ensino Médio Completo e Curso técnico em Mecânica/Mecatrônica;


Desejável

  • NR-35, NR-33;
  • Experiência de 6 meses em funções semelhantes.


Localidade

  • Limeira/SP
  • Americana/SP


Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.


Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).


Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test at XILO , a fast-growing AI-driven startup transforming the insurance industry. With 200+ clients, growing data, and fresh Series A funding, we’re scaling quickly — and we’re looking for someone to help us ensure quality and reliability at every step.


The Role:

You’ll lead the charge in shaping and scaling our test automation strategy , with a focus on end-to-end testing using Playwright and TypeScript. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to define best practices, build test coverage for new and existing features, and make testing a first-class citizen in our development lifecycle.


This is not a passive testing role — you’ll be embedded in sprint planning and start writing tests before the features are even built , anticipating behavior, aligning with developers, and enabling test-first workflows. While your main focus will be automation, you’ll also support high-priority manual validation when needed.


You’ll take ownership of:

  • Designing, maintaining, and improving our Playwright-based E2E test suites
  • Writing test coverage for cross-service platform workflows and domain-specific modules
  • Defining testing standards, tooling, and patterns used across all teams
  • Partnering with developers during sprint planning to prepare test coverage in advance
  • Leading CI/CD test integration and improving overall test stability and performance
  • Supporting critical release testing and mentoring engineers on writing integration/unit tests


What You’ll Bring:

  • ✔️ 5+ years of experience in software testing , with a strong focus on automation
  • ✔️ Deep knowledge of Playwright and TypeScript , and a track record of building resilient test systems
  • ✔️ Experience writing system-level and module-level E2E tests in a modern web platform
  • ✔️ Comfort working closely with developers and PMs to build test-first workflows
  • ✔️ Experience designing test strategies , introducing tools, and improving CI pipelines
  • ✔️ Bonus: Familiarity with Jest , Postman , Sonar , or performance/load testing tools


Why Join XILO?

  • ✅ A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • ✅ Endless career growth – Help define testing culture across teams and services
  • ✅ Strong leadership & backing – Work with experienced founders and top-tier investors
  • ✅ Full ownership – From strategy to tooling, you’ll shape how we ship confidently


If you’re looking for a high-impact QA/automation role where your work enables engineering velocity, product confidence, and great user experiences, let’s chat!

title: QA Automation Engineer Sr
description:
QA Automation Engineer

We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer  to join our global team and help us ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of Fielo’s products.If you are passionate about automation, testing, and collaboration in an agile environment — this is for you.


What you’ll do

Collaborate in cross-functional, agile teams to design and implement automated test suites for APIs, UX, and UI.

Work closely with backend and frontend engineers, product managers, and UX designers to identify and resolve issues.

Build and maintain regression testing suites for Fielo applications using Playwright with TypeScript.

Design, develop, and support innovative testing strategies to enhance QA automation.

Report the status and progress of automation and quality projects.

Reproduce, troubleshoot, and document production issues.

Ensure regression testing coverage across product configurations and use cases.

Integrate automated tests with GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines.


Who you are

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

5+ years of experience in QA automation.

Advanced skills in JavaScript and REST API testing.

Hands-on experience writing and executing tests using Playwright.

Strong knowledge of Cucumber, Selenium, Ruby, and test automation frameworks.

Experience with JMeter for performance/load testing.

Familiarity with Pega-based applications (nice to have).

Knowledge of Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.


What we’re looking for

Proven experience in QA automation and testing APIs (Soap, Postman, etc.).

High analytical and problem-solving skills.

Knowledge of non-relational databases.

Ability to write reusable code and apply object-oriented paradigms to automated tests.

Advanced spoken and written English.

Initiative, curiosity, and a mindset for continuous improvement.


Bonus points

ISTQB or similar testing certification.

Experience working with Pega projects.

Familiarity with the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).


Why Fielo?

You’ll join a diverse and collaborative team working on cutting-edge solutions in the SaaS industry — where your work directly contributes to customer success and product quality at scale.

title: SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester who wants to learn and transform his career.

Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and execute test concepts, automated or manual test script for cross platform mobile app SAP Service and Asset Manager and foundation framework Mobile Development Kit for Windows.

Follow SAP’s software quality standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in automation development and testing for mobile applications, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, with Behavior Driven Development, Java, JMeter, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system, Jenkins etc.

Actively collaborate with frontend and backend developers to report functional issues, crashes, and performance problems, and validate fixes and resolution as required. Ensure test plant and results are maintained in the central Global Test Platform system for reporting and traceability.

Provide sufficient documentations on test environment, test results, re-produce steps

title: Technical Writer
description:
Overview: Algoseek is seeking a Technical Writer – Financial Documentation to create clear, structured, and comprehensive documentation for our datasets and APIs. This role requires both technical precision and financial knowledge, turning complex data and APIs into content that is accurate, accessible, and client-friendly. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and product teams to ensure consistency, clarity, and usability across all documentation.


Role Details:

  • Location: 100% Remote (Global Team)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive, with additional growth opportunities


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and structured documentation for financial APIs, datasets, and schemas.
  • Create detailed descriptions of datasets, fields, parameters, and references with consistent terminology.
  • Explain complex financial concepts (market data, instruments, indicators) in simple, client-friendly language .
  • Provide usage examples (sample queries, API calls, JSON responses) for APIs and datasets.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product managers to gather technical details.
  • Define and enforce documentation standards, style guides, and consistency across products.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on feedback from clients and internal teams.


Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Writer, Data Documentation Specialist, or related role .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, datasets, data models, and JSON structures .
  • Background in finance or trading , with knowledge of instruments, market data, or financial reporting.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts.
  • Ability to structure and organize large sets of documentation logically and consistently .
  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data, QA).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., OpenAPI).
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools and metadata management.
  • Basic knowledge of Python .
  • Understanding of developer experience and user-centered documentation design.
  • Prior work in fintech, data providers, or market intelligence platforms .
  • Ability to create visual aids (ER diagrams, data flow charts, architecture overviews).


Work Hours:

  • Flexible remote setup with required availability for critical U.S. market overlap hours . (fixed EST hours – 9 to 1PM)
  • Occasional late-evening coverage for key delivery periods.


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, structured documentation that makes complex datasets and APIs accessible .
  • Consistent terminology and standards across all technical content .
  • Documentation that improves client adoption and reduces support overhead.
  • Positive feedback from internal teams and external clients on clarity and usability.


Why Join Algoseek?

  • Work with a leading provider of high-quality market data and trading solutions.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and financial experts.
  • Drive innovation in automated trading systems and distributed market data solutions.
  • Be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team with a culture of ownership and excellence.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
  • A 100% remote work setup with flexibility for work-life balance.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an innovative, fast-paced market data company.
  • Professional development opportunities to help you grow into higher leadership roles.
  • If you’re a skilled finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief overview of your background and availability.

Executar, revisar e analisar processos contábeis e fiscais de empresas enquadradas nos regimes Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional, garantindo a conformidade das demonstrações contábeis, o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a aderência às normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes..

Profissional detalhista, proativo(a), comprometido(a) com prazos e qualidade técnica, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e disposição para contribuir com a melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis.
